source: Scope. This handbook establishes the execution mental model needed by the rest of the Understanding AI Systems series. Memory hierarchy, Roofline analysis, coalescing, shared-memory tiling, register/occupancy tuning, Tensor Core programming, and profiling each receive deeper standalone handbooks later. Here they are introduced only far enough to make ZXNAME0000XZ architecture coherent.
zh: 范围。本手册建立了理解人工智能系统系列其余部分所需的执行心智模型。内存层次结构、Roofline 分析、合并、共享内存平铺、寄存器/占用调整、Tensor Core 编程和分析稍后都会收到更深入的独立手册。这里对它们的介绍仅足以使 ZXNAME0000XZ 架构保持一致。
